title: "Sharing & archiving" module (Zenodo, GEO/SRA, protocols.io, OSF)
context: Cancer researchers often lack knowledge of archiving standards, appropriate data/code repositories, licensing for shared research outputs, and how to write effective data/code-availability statements that satisfy funder and journal mandates. This module teaches the full sharing/archiving workflow using concrete, open-access tools (Zenodo, GEO/SRA, protocols.io, OSF) with a runnable exercise and instructor notes. Depends on: template-004, container-ci-005.
objective: Author the 'Sharing & archiving' module covering Zenodo, GEO/SRA submission, protocols.io, OSF, data/code-availability statements, and output licensing following the module template, with 3-6 Bloom-aligned learning objectives, a runnable exercise, checklist/takeaway, formative assessment, and instructor notes; CI green; signed off by Educator and Domain reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Module follows the template: 3-6 Bloom-aligned learning objectives, lesson narrative with all assertions cited, runnable pinned-container exercise, worked example or synthetic exercise, checklist/takeaway, formative assessment, and instructor notes.
Teaches Zenodo (depositing code/data, versioning, citing DOIs), GEO/SRA submission (at a conceptual level), protocols.io for protocol sharing, and OSF for project archiving.
Covers writing a data/code-availability statement: correct licensing (CC-BY-4.0 for content, MIT for code), choosing the right repository, and attribution requirements.
Hands-on exercise runs in a pinned container and passes CI (Docker + Apptainer); uses synthetic data; no raw cancer data committed.
No biological/clinical conclusion presented as a finding.
All lesson assertions cited; link/citation checker passes in CI.
Reviewed and signed off by Educator reviewer and Domain reviewer; DCO signed off.
output: A complete 'Sharing & archiving' module committed to the project repo (lesson, exercise with synthetic data, checklist, assessment, instructor notes) with CI green (Docker + Apptainer) and Educator + Domain reviewer sign-offs.
